headline: The plugin works — no more VB-CABLE
note: Soundstage now runs inside Windows' own audio engine. It's installed on your Realtek output and proven by measurement: asked for -20 dB, measured -20.00 dB at the plugin's own output. Three separate Windows requirements had to be found before it would load at all, and audiodg crashed a few times on the way. Your AV receiver is attached too, but it went into standby before I could confirm 8-channel — play something through it and it should just work.
updated: APO working and pushed, plus plugin mode in the UI and per-speaker meters

items.text: Soundstage APO - our own audio plugin
Found the hidden second registration Windows requires
COM aggregation - the engine demands it
IAudioSystemEffects3 - refusing it crashed all audio
Loads inside audiodg and locks the stream
Plugin mode in Settings, with install and undo
Level meter on every speaker fader
Visual direction mockups - sent as an artifact
Left for you: play something on the AV receiver to confirm 8ch
